name: Tomato condiments (ketchup, salsa)

other_form.scope: Fruiting vegetables (including tomato, cucumber, pepper, and similar vegetables)
Tomatoes, preserved by heat treatment and hermetically sealed

Cd.binding_scope: solid foods in general except categories with particular limits

other_form.scope: fruiting vegetables excluding tomatoes and edible fungi
Fruiting vegetables other than cucurbits (excluding tomatoes and edible fungi)
Fruiting vegetables, other than Cucurbits and tomatoes

iAs.rationale: No sovereign inorganic-arsenic ML exists for tomato condiments; total arsenic is governed (500, tomato concentrates). Inorganic arsenic is controlled by reflex speciation on any elevated total arsenic.
iAs.reference_method: Total As by ICP-MS; reflex iAs speciation (HPLC-ICP-MS) on any total-As exceedance.

MeHg.rationale: No methylation pathway and no fish source in a tomato condiment.

Ni.label: read-across from EU 2024/1987 fruiting-vegetables nickel 400 — tomatoes are fruiting vegetables; the source-commodity nickel ML applied at face value.

Cr.rationale: A sovereign total-chromium context does exist for the source commodity: Hong Kong Cap 132V sets total chromium at 500 ug/kg for vegetables other than pulses (hk_cap132v_crtotal_vegetables-other-than-pulses_500), and tomato condiments are a fruiting-vegetable product, so the vegetable total-chromium ML is the nearest sovereign analog. Because a real source pathway exists, the cell is held under a reflex screen disclosed against the Hong Kong vegetables total-chromium ML (500) rather than declared not-material; any total-chromium exceedance triggers Cr(VI) speciation.
Cr.reference_method: Total Cr by ICP-MS screen; reflex Cr(VI) speciation (EPA 3060A + EPA 6800 / EN 15192) on any total-Cr exceedance.

Cr-VI.rationale: Hexavalent chromium is never a panel number for a food; it is the reflex-speciation species. Any total-chromium exceedance is speciated, and any quantifiable Cr(VI) fails.
Cr-VI.reference_method: IC-ICP-MS Cr(VI) speciation on any total-Cr exceedance.

Sn.rationale: Tin migrates only from tinplate cans; this subcategory is bottled ketchup and salsa in glass or plastic. Canned tomato condiments carry the canned-food tin ML and are out of scope here.

Al.rationale: No sovereign aluminium ML exists for tomato condiments and no aluminium pathway operates in a bottled product. Rebuttable and audited each build.

method: HMTc Method v2.0 (government-limit default; face value, no reconstitution; read-across / control / not-material for unregulated cells; no occurrence percentiles)
lineage_note: Ketchup and salsa are certified against the stricter tomato-CONCENTRATE lead and total-arsenic MLs (Pb/tAs 500, Paraguay/MERCOSUR) rather than the looser finished-ketchup (Singapore 2000) or generic-sauce (Vietnam 'Sauce' Pb 2000 / tAs 1000) MLs — a protective, government-cited choice; the finished-ketchup, generic-sauce, and canned/preserved whole-tomato MLs (Pb 50) are retained in the per-country audit trail as different product forms. Cadmium is governed by the stricter Uruguay RBN general limit for SOLID foods (Cd 200; uy_rbn_general_cd_solid_foods_0_2mgkg), a semisolid tomato condiment being a solid food; this binds below the Vietnam 'Sauce' Cd 1000, and no tomato-specific cadmium value exists (tomatoes are explicitly carved OUT of the fruiting-vegetable cadmium ML). Total mercury (50) is governed by the Vietnam generic 'Sauce' category. Nickel reads across from the EU fruiting-vegetable Ni ML (400) because tomatoes are fruiting vegetables. Total chromium is held under a reflex screen disclosed against the Hong Kong Cap 132V vegetables-other-than-pulses total-chromium ML (500), tomato being a fruiting vegetable. Canned tomato condiments fall under the canned-food tin ML and are out of this bottled subcategory's scope.

warnings: tomato-condiments[default].Pb: informational — stricter rows exist for a different product form (TH 50 [preserved tomatoes]; GSO 50 [Preserved tomatoes]; IL 50 [Fruiting vegetables (including tomato, c]; HK 50 [Tomatoes, preserved by heat treatment an])

tomato-condiments[default].Cd: informational — stricter rows exist for a different product form (PH 50 [fruiting vegetables excluding tomatoes a]; IN 50 [Fruiting vegetables other than cucurbits]; VN 50 [Fruit vegetables (excluding tomatoes and]; HK 50 [Fruiting vegetables, other than Cucurbit])
